concept: Lambda + API Gateway: pay per request instead of an idle EC2
tests: Re-architecting a rarely used always-on API to serverless to stop paying for idle time.
expected: Move the API to Lambda behind API Gateway — pay per request/execution, scale to zero. Triggers: "sporadic traffic", "idle for hours", "short bursts", "don't pay for idle", "available on demand".
why_not: A 3-year RI means paying 24/7 for idle time; Spot is cheaper but can be reclaimed (2 min) and still runs constantly; gp2→gp3 saves a little on disk but does not eliminate instance idle time.
